description: Aboriginal Housing Services As Constructed - sewer_fitting (DOC-015) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Communities. This dataset contains sewer reticulation fittings and infrastructure for selected remote Aboriginal settlements in Western Australia e. g. pumps, valves, manholes and septic tanks. These point features have been derived from as-constructed surveys of remote Aboriginal settlements dating back to 1995. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Communities. Its tags are aboriginal housing services, aboriginal-settlements, as-constructed, sewer. It offers 7 resource(s) in api arcgis server map service, audio/basic, fgdb, geojson, geopackage. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Custom (Government Use). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
